title: Rising frustration, payment difficulty and callback
description: Service call about a delayed claim. The customer becomes increasingly frustrated, then reveals a job loss and asks for a callback; the agent sticks to process.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good morning, this is Neha from Nivaran Health Insurance. This call is recorded for quality and training. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I'm calling about my reimbursement claim. I submitted all the documents three weeks ago.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure, may I have your policy number please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I already gave it to the last person. Fine, it's N H four five six seven eight.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Could you also confirm your date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: This is the third time I'm calling about this. Every single time I have to repeat everything.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me check. Your claim is under review, and we need the original pharmacy bills.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: What? Nobody told me that! This is ridiculous, I have wasted so much time on this.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: As per the process, the documents must be submitted in original.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: And honestly, money is really tight right now. I lost my job last month and I can't even pay my renewal premium next week.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your renewal premium is fourteen thousand two hundred rupees, due on the fifteenth.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I can't talk now, I'm getting late. Can someone call me back in the evening?
